topic.title: Marine Plans / Marine Policy Assessment / Marine Licensing
topic.source_contract: marine plan area, project coordinates and tidal extent, applicable marine policies, policy assessment, environmental designations, land-sea interaction, alternatives, cumulative effects, marine licence or DCO relationship, consultation, decision, conditions, implementation and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: Location in a marine plan area is not policy compliance.
Explore Marine Plans data is not a licence decision.
A marine policy assessment is not a marine licence.
A planning permission is not automatically a marine authorisation.
Proposed mitigation is not evidence of implementation.
A licence grant is not discharge of all conditions.
Monitoring commitments are not measured marine outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact coordinates, policy assessment, authorisation, implementation and monitoring evidence.
